extensions.org.licoland.adapter.kilo/purpose: The Kilo Code adapter: the headless serve driver, the endpoint policy the Agent owns and the vendor protocol that classifies one HTTP/SSE document exactly once below the adapter port, plus the agent-execution registration an installed Kilo Code client uses. The kernel owns no part of Kilo Code and depends on none of it.
extensions.org.licoland.adapter.kilo/persistentData: This package declares no conversion because it owns no persisted package data of its own: it writes no data home, no cache and no store. The session records it reads belong to the installed Kilo Code client, and the client's own conversation store remains the kernel's. The endpoint state directory the serve engine writes is the client's record of a process it started, not package data.
